title: Trips to the Moon
author: of Samosata Lucian
description: "Trips to the Moon" by Lucian is a satirical work likely written in the 2nd century AD.
longDescription: This piece primarily comprises comedic narratives that playfully critique the absurdities of human belief and contemporary historiography, employing imaginative elements and fantastic voyages to convey its messages.

authorInfo.bio: of Samosata Lucian (120–180) wrote Trips to the Moon. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
